title: Vector representing a frequency
statement: Given a binary subspace splitting of $H\subseteq bF_2^n$ and $gamma\in bF_2^d$, the lifted frequency is the unique vector in $ bF_2^n$ whose dot product with each $z\in bF_2^n$ equals the frequency functional associated to $gamma$ evaluated at $z$.
hypotheses_covered: A binary subspace splitting of $H\subseteq bF_2^n$
